name: protodeck
description: Prototype server for coding agents: HTML screens with Tailwind and components, shown together in device frames, with a chat bar that drives your agent.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-assets.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.build:bin: node scripts/gen-assets.mjs && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --minify --outfile bin/protodeck
